text.ms:
1. (1)  Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Harga dan
Antipencatutan (Penentuan Harga Maksimum) (No. 4) 2015.

(2)  Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Julai 2015.

Harga maksimum pengeluar

2. Harga maksimum pe ngeluar bagi barangan harga terkawal yang din yatakan
dalam ruang (1) Jadual  hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam
ruang (3)(i) Jadual.

Harga maksimum borong

3. Harga maksimum borong bagi barangan harga terkawal yang dinyatakan dalam
ruang (1) Jadual hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3)(ii) Jadual.

Harga maksimum runcit

4. Harga maksimum runcit bagi barangan harga terkawal yang dinyatakan dalam
ruang (1) Jadual hendaklah sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (3)(iii) Jadual.

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING ACT 2011

PRICE CONTROL AND ANTI-PROFITEERING
(DETERMINATION OF MAXIMUM PRICE) (NO. 4) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 4 of
the Price Control and Anti-Profiteering Act 2011 [ Act 723 ], the Controller, with the
approval of the Minister, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement
1. (1)   This order may be cited as the Price Control and Anti -Profiteering
(Determination of Maximum Price) (No. 4) Order 2015.

(2)  This Order comes into operation on 1 July 2015.

Maximum producer price
2. The maximum producer price for the price -controlled goods speci fied in
column (1) of the Schedule shall be as specified in column (3)(i) of the Schedule.

Maximum wholesale price
3. The maximum wholesale price for the price -controlled goods s pecified in
column (1) of the Schedule shall be as specified in column (3)(ii) of the Schedule.

Maximum retail price
4. The maximum retail price for the price -controlled goods specified in column (1)
of the Schedule shall be as specified in column (3)(iii) of the Schedule.
